speakNow: Speak now. Ask about weather or prices, or say “open mandi”.
deniedTitle: The microphone is off for Arth
step1: Tap the lock icon next to the web address at the top.
step2: Open Permissions (or Site settings) and set Microphone to Allow.
step3: If Arth is installed as an app: phone Settings → Apps → Arth → Permissions → Microphone.
privacy: Your voice is not saved. It is used only to answer you.

errors.denied: Arth does not have permission to use the microphone.
errors.unsupported: Voice recording does not work in this browser. Please try opening Arth in Chrome.
errors.noMic: No microphone found. Check that no other app is using it.
errors.tooShort: I could not hear that. Speak a little longer, then tap stop.
errors.offline: No internet. Try again when you have network.
errors.timeout: The answer took too long. Please try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
